svg.title: Sheet 3 of 4, detail B, AI systems, with a live eye aspect ratio trace that raises an alert on a drowsy dip: EyeDTrack, real-time driver attention monitoring, thesis. 713 milliseconds from camera capture to result at the 95th percentile, on one phone at a desk in November 2026; 1,200+ automated checks on the server, the app and the phone; 26 of 30 yawn alerts were real yawns, an idealized episode count from a sealed final test that met 0 of its 15 accuracy targets. Team lead; Kotlin, Python, OpenCV; MobileNetV2 and LLaVA; February to June 2025.
